capabilities: Automatically open specified notes in Reading View
Set the default view mode (Live Preview, Source mode, or unchanged) for other notes
Select target notes via fuzzy search autocompletion in settings
Leave view mode switching to the user after a note opens
extras: The README stresses the plugin is non-destructive and only changes the UI view level, never writing to files; it also notes installation from Community Plugins or manual release files.
problem: Obsidian opens every note in the same view mode, so dashboard-style notes meant for reading get opened in editing mode unless switched manually each time.
summary: Plugin that automatically opens designated notes in Reading View and sets the default view mode for all other notes.
